headline: ماذا حدث حين بدأت فرق في المستشفيات تعقد اجتماعًا قصيرًا عن سلامة المرضى؟
reviewer: AI editorial review using the owner's arabic-editorial-reviewer and english-editorial-reviewer agents (not a human reader test)

introduction_answers.problem: قد يرى العاملون في المستشفى خطرًا يهدد مريضًا، ثم لا يجدون وقتًا أو مكانًا مناسبًا للحديث عنه، والأحداث الضارة ضرر تسببه الرعاية نفسها.
introduction_answers.who: فرق المستشفيات من أطباء وممرضين وسائر المهن، ومرضاهم.
introduction_answers.change: اجتماع قصير ومنظم عن المخاطر؛ وفي تجربة عشوائية انخفض معدل الأحداث الضارة 12% بعد بدء الاجتماعات، لكن كثيرًا منها لا يُعقد بالطريقة التي صُمّم بها.

summary: في تجربة عشوائية في أربعة مستشفيات جامعية انخفض معدل الأحداث الضارة بنسبة 12% بعد أن بدأ الأطباء اجتماعًا قصيرًا عن السلامة، وتُظهر دراسات أخرى أن الاجتماعات كثيرًا ما تُعقد ناقصة.
terminology_evidence: Safety huddle, adverse event, fidelity, safety culture, psychological safety and stepped-wedge cluster randomised trial are explained at first use or in the glossary; English terms are in parentheses after the Arabic.
language_evidence: Arabic revised after a strict sentence-by-sentence arabic-editorial-reviewer pass returned BLOCK; every BLOCK/FIX applied and re-reviewed. English reviewed with english-editorial-reviewer. 'Daily' removed from the title and claims because the Toronto abstract does not state huddle frequency and the Taiwan ward met twice a week. Editorial simulation, not a human reader test.

mobile_evidence.scope: Automated rendered-layout verification; screenshots retained for human visual review

source_evidence.claim: Stepped-wedge cluster randomised trial, 4 academic hospitals, physicians; at least 9 months in intervention; blinded chart audits of 912 randomly selected patients; adjusted adverse-event rate 12% lower (RR 0.88, 95% CI 0.80-0.98); mean attendance per site 30-85%; mean issues raised and actions taken per huddle 1.6-3.1; 'Communication about error' positive score 36% to 64%
source_evidence.assessment: Stepped-wedge cluster RCT (Guo et al., BMJ Qual Saf 2025)

source_evidence.claim: HUSH: 92 wards in 5 hospitals, huddles embedded in 64; mean fidelity 4.9 of 9 elements; SPC charts and review of historical harms most often omitted; positive change on 26 of 27 teamwork and safety climate items
source_evidence.assessment: Mixed-methods evaluation (Lamming et al., BMC HSR 2021)

source_evidence.claim: 74 UK ICU responses, 71 use huddles; registered nurses attended most consistently (n=63, 89%), medical staff less often (n=8, 32%) - percentages on different bases (63/71; 8/~25); most without a structured evidence-based framework; drawbacks time burden, perceived irrelevance, care interruptions, lack of psychological safety

Seoul tertiary teaching hospital, 4 surgical units, 89 staff nurses; workshops for huddle leaders and staff nurses; 12-week huddles with coaching visits; single-group pre-post; 9 outcomes (organizational learning, situation monitoring, mutual support, speaking-up climate, promotive and prohibitive voice, job satisfaction, patient safety, quality of care); significant improvement in 6 of 9; qualitative data identified challenges to participation
source_evidence.assessment: Mixed-methods pre-post study without control group (Lee et al., 2023)

source_evidence.claim: 74-bed general medical ward, Taiwan; huddles started twice a week; 44 huddles 9 Sep 2020 to 30 Sep 2021; 81 issues identified and resolved; 67 (82.7%) quick hits (resolved within 24-48 h), mean 5.17 h; 14 complex issues, mean 19.73 days; staff evaluation by anonymous questionnaire; no comparison group

decision: CI candidate PASS only; authoritative approval is successful GitHub Actions job
